acceptance_criteria: Template static/media URL helpers should prepend the active script prefix for root-relative settings.
FileSystemStorage and StaticFilesStorage URL generation should use the current script prefix dynamically.
Hashed staticfiles processing should not leave CSS references rooted at /static/ when runtime URLs are script-prefixed.
issue: STATIC_URL and MEDIA_URL generation should honor dynamic SCRIPT_NAME for root-relative URLs without affecting absolute or protocol-relative URLs.
